description: This file implements the methods for the CoolSystemData class, handling data initialization, storage, and file output for cooling system simulations.

classes.name: CoolSystemData
classes.description: A class managing data collection, histogram storage, and file output for a cooling system simulation.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes histograms with maximum flow rate and energy based on system parameters.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores current system data into histograms and resets temporary data.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes collected data and histograms to a CSV file.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens a CSV file for appending data, with filename based on a prefix.
